survey: A single brown leather cowboy boot in side view, toe pointing right, floating on a plain radial background with no ground plane, which is normal for an icon. The tall shaft has stitched decoration and a scalloped top with tan lining visible inside. A stitched seam joins the shaft to the foot section, and the foot narrows to a pointed toe. A dark brown sole runs under the foot into a stacked, forward-angled heel block under the back of the boot; it meets the sole and upper cleanly. A gold spur sits at the back of the heel: a spiked rowel on a pin at the end of a short shank pointing backward, and a straight arm (heel band) running forward along the visible side of the heel counter. The arm ends in a rounded tip partway along the boot side, with no button and no strap.

errors.where: Gold spur, front end of the heel band on the side of the boot heel
errors.what: The spur arm stops in a bare rounded tip against the leather. It has no button and no strap over the instep or under the arch, so nothing holds the spur on the boot. It looks glued to the side, like a loose end, rather than strapped around the heel the way a real spur is.

fix: Make the gold spur's heel band a U-shaped band that wraps around the back of the boot heel, with a small button at the front end of each arm and a thin leather spur strap from the buttons over the top of the instep, so the spur is clearly strapped onto the boot.
